title: Visitor Orientation — Blacksand City Network
author: Widow Administrative Office — Blacksand City
content:
WELCOME TO THEEV.

You have been cleared through the Skull. This means someone vouched for you, or you bought your way in, or both. Either way, you are here now.

The Law of the Lords applies in this starport, in the Upper City, and in any building or zone marked with red flags. Under the Law of the Lords: no murder, no weapons fire, no conduct that disturbs the calm and tranquility of the city.

Everywhere else — the canyons, the lower streets, any unflagged zone — the Law of the Street applies. The only restriction in street zones is a prohibition on any weapon capable of breaching environmental containment.

The punishment for violating either law is the same.

Death.

The red flag zones move. A building that is protected today may not be protected tomorrow. Plan accordingly.

The Widows are always watching. You will not see them until it is relevant.

Welcome to Blacksand City.

title: Shipyard Notice — Kallos Shipyards
author: Kallos Shipyards Front Office
content:
KALLOS SHIPYARDS — ACQUISITION, REFITTING, RECYCLING

We buy ships. We sell ships. We ask no questions about where either came from.

Hull assessments available for a modest fee. No Imperial registry required. No transponder history examined.

Note regarding recycled vessels: Stripping takes approximately ten days for vessels under 600 tons. Larger hulls on request. We do not accept vessels with active tracking beacons unless the beacon has been disabled prior to arrival. We will not disable it for you. We do not know how.

Note regarding new acquisitions: Our current inventory includes three scout hulls, one armed merchant (transponder scrubbed), and what appears to be a decommissioned Imperial customs cutter. The cutter is priced to move.

We do not inquire into intended use. We recommend you extend us the same courtesy.

Kallos Shipyards. Discretion guaranteed or your money back.

(Money-back policy has never been exercised. We intend to keep it that way.)

title: Arrivals Log — Security Notation
author: Widow Administrative Office — Internal
content:
ARRIVALS — SECURITY NOTATION — CURRENT CYCLE

Vessel via Krrsh clearance codes. Hull unregistered. Crew: multiple. Manifests not filed. No affiliation declared.

Note: Krrsh clearance codes are considered valid. Krrsh himself is not currently on Theev. His codes being used without him present is unusual.

Note: A spy named Gesh has already filed an inquiry regarding this vessel's association with Drinax. Gesh's inquiry has been logged. We do not act on third-party inquiries without cause.

Note: Crew has been met and orientation provided. Standard watch assigned. Elevated if they enter lower city without escort.

— Recommend observation. Do not intervene unless Lord's Law is broken.
